architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Replace or isolate unmaintained paste/rustls-pemfile dependencies
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Dependency tree and audit show a deliberate maintained path; TLS/protocol checks and aarch64 build pass. T32's security patches remain verified, but these maintenance warnings are open.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Drive-local timeout and independent torque-limit handshake
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Enable requires verified per-model firmware parameter write/readback. Software mock failure cases fail closed; installed-drive timeout/torque behavior needs separate physical acceptance.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Hardware E-stop and Hall method/polarity honesty
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Wire the selected input path, health/polarity/search contract, or reject unsupported configuration. Never publish a fabricated clear line. Physical wiring/stop/support behavior is a separate acceptance gate.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Wrong-sign policy coordinate and per-pose contract
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Document joint versus motor frame and per-joint/profile expectations; reject unsupported policy rather than infer sign from angle alone. Leave current deliberately disabled policy unchanged until validated physical acceptance.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Reject unsupported or malformed dynamics models
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Construction rejects cycles, zero axes, invalid mass/inertials and unsupported prismatic/mimic/floating-base capabilities, or implements and independently verifies them. No hang or nonfinite torque from rejected input.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Bound realtime command work and measure loop jitter
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Priority stop/fault cannot wait behind bulk commands; disk/audit work stays outside the control owner. Deterministic flood/stalled-I/O tests pass; actual Pi jitter measurements remain a physical runtime gate.

architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.title: Current CAD and model provenance plus scope honesty
architecture_and_maintenance_tasks.acceptance: Record source/CAD/export/model/config identities and inertial provenance, reconcile recovered older exports without overwriting the five-joint master, and identify scaffolds as unsupported. Current geometry and mass/COM acceptance needs independent/physical evidence.
